title: Responsibility Boundaries for Agentic Systems: A Comparative Evaluation of Probabilistic Agentic Programming
abstract: arXiv:2610.33312v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language-model agents combine reasoning, tools, memory, delegation, and external effects. Authority is often distributed across prompts, host code, configuration, and logs. Probabilistic Agentic Programming (PAP) makes responsibility boundaries explicit programming abstractions connecting mandate, authority, effects, and evidence. We compare PAP with programming paradigms, agent-oriented and BDI systems, workflow and policy languages, and LLM tool-use frameworks along seven dimensions. A mediation kernel formalizes checks before tool execution, operation-bound approval, resource limits, and evidence. Inductive proofs establish conditional safety for arbitrary model responses, assuming correct guards and complete mediation. A backward simulation matches graph executions to source executions in a defined sequential Touba subset. Its human checkpoints release program continuations; operation-bound approval remains a separate kernel contra

translated_title: 智能体系统的责任边界：概率智能体编程的比较评估
translated_abstract: 语言模型智能体结合了推理、工具、记忆、委托和外部效应，而权限往往分散在提示词、宿主代码、配置和日志之中。概率智能体编程将责任边界作为显式编程抽象，连接授权、权限、效应与证据。我们从七个维度将PAP与编程范式、面向智能体和BDI系统、工作流与策略语言以及LLM工具使用框架进行了比较。中介内核将工具执行前的检查、基于操作的审批、资源限制和证据形式化。归纳证明在守卫正确且中介完备的假设下，为任意模型响应建立了条件安全性。反向模拟在定义的顺序Touba子集中将图执行与源执行相匹配。人工检查点负责释放程序延续，基于操作的审批则保持为独立内核。
tldr: 该论文提出概率智能体编程（PAP），将责任边界作为显式编程抽象，通过中介内核、条件安全性归纳证明和反向模拟，为语言模型智能体的授权、审批与证据追踪提供形式化保障。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Probabilistic Agentic Programming (PAP), which makes responsibility boundaries explicit programming abstractions, providing formalized guarantees for authorization, approval, and evidence tracing of language-model agents through a mediation kernel, inductive conditional safety proofs, and backward simulation.
